pr_title: Do not reload page after adding comments in Pull Request reviews
pr_body:
Fixes #8861.

Use ajax on PR review page for submitting review comments, adding replies and (un)resolving conversations, instead of refreshing the entire page on each interaction.

This is very painful while reviewing files more than 100 with huge content.

review_comments: This block is mostly duplicate with the block below. Maybe it's worth factoring out the duplicated parts into a separate function?
I'm new to golang. Is this an OK way to remove the pending reviews from the array? I got it from https://github.com/golang/go/wiki/SliceTricks#filter-in-place.

This is fine unless the slice is very big initially, much smaller afterwards and likely to hang around for a long time, or very big with only a few removals

* if you think the slice is going to hang around a long time and is quite big initially and small afterwards you should allocate a new a slice of the correct size at the end and issue `copy(filtered, slice)`

* If the slice is very big and is going to have only a few removals you should do: 
```go
	i := 0
	for i < len(slice) {
 		if !removing {
			i++
			continue
		}
		copy(slice[i:], slice[i+1:])
		slice= slice[:len(slice)-1]   
 	}
```

if the slice is expected to be less than 10, as it is,  then this is fine
Thank you for the review. I will apply your suggestions. I don't understand what you mean by this comment though?
Since we can't predict how many comments will be fetched from database, we can't give a meaningful capability on the make.
I think he meant that comments variable needs to be initialized using make
I think this is fine - AFAIU xorm will generate the comments array as appropriate in Find.
